channel.title: Marcos Kuchak · Field notes
channel.description: Notes on AI agents, LLM systems and full-stack engineering.

item.title: I took the AI out of my Git CLI, and it got better
item.description: Sugar Git started as a handful of aliases in 2021, gained AI commit messages in 2024 and lost them in 2026. Then came 44 releases in three months. What changed, why, and what sgit does today.

item.title: Entities your agent can't break
item.description: These days an agent writes a good chunk of your domain code, and it takes whatever path the code leaves open. How to model creating and restoring entities in TypeScript, with classes, so the wrong shortcut doesn't even compile.

item.title: Usend: Send Emails for Free with JavaScript
item.description: Explore a free service that offers seamless integration for sending emails in Node.js applications. With features like simple integration, flexibility, DKIM security, and vendor support, Usend provides a cost-effective solution for developers. Learn how to get started and enhance your email communication effortlessly.
